ziwin: For this reason, my mother said, I should not do much alone in quills until I was as tall as my cousin Warca-Ziwin.
My grown-up cousin, Warca-Ziwin (Sunflower), who was then seventeen, always went to the river alone for water for her mother.
And soon your uncle died also, leaving a widow and an orphan daughter, your cousin Warca-Ziwin.
So I said: "Mother, when I am tall as my cousin Warca-Ziwin, you shall not have to come for water.
ziwin's: In the busy autumn days my cousin Warca-Ziwin's mother came to our wigwam to help my mother preserve foods for our winter use.
